independent_computation.what_is_computable: The permitted evidence does not define the disposition vocabulary, so the map's individual entries are not checkable here. What IS computable from cached wiki text is the question the leaf answers: whether this scenario's combat leaves are view-dependent, i.e. whether one scalar per leaf is well-defined without a disposition/view tag. That is a decidable question, and the answer is no.

mandate_vulnerable.damage_types: ALL (text says 'the damage they take from all sources', unqualified by type)
mandate_vulnerable.beneficiary: every damage source on the roster, not just the holder ('from all sources')
mandate_vulnerable.gate: 4 s window opened by an immobilize; extended, not stacked, by subsequent immobilizes

abyssal_unmake.applier: the Abyssal holder (aura anchored on the holder)
abyssal_unmake.beneficiary: every damage source on the roster ('from all sources')
abyssal_unmake.gate: target within 700 units (center to edge) of the HOLDER — not of the attacker

step_2_key_asymmetries: Both amps are team-wide in benefit but single-holder in application. In a roster where the Mandate carrier and the Abyssal carrier are not the damage dealer, a leaf's value depends on participants other than the one the leaf is nominally about. This is precisely the 'coupled' regime of S4.

The two amps have DIFFERENT scopes: Mandate is damage-type-agnostic, Abyssal is magic-only. So two leaves of the same scenario, at the same instant, against the same target, correctly carry different multipliers.

The two amps have DIFFERENT gates: Mandate is a 4 s time window keyed to an immobilize event; Abyssal is a 700-unit proximity band keyed to the holder's position. So the same leaf correctly carries different multipliers at different times / geometries.

step_3_enumerate_the_legitimate_values.note: Independent 'increased damage taken' sources compose multiplicatively; the composition is stated nowhere in docs/math-foundations.md (S5), which is itself part of the argument.

cases.view: roster, Vulnerable window live, outside 700u or non-magic
roster, cursed but Vulnerable window expired

step_4_why_absent_fails.conclusion: Four distinct multipliers (1.0, 1.07, 1.12, 1.1984) are all CORRECT within this one scenario, differing only by damage type, by amplifier window, and by whose view the number is taken from. Untagged, a golden snapshot cannot separate 'this leaf is physical so it correctly lacks the 12% curse' from 'the 12% curse regressed off this leaf' — the two are numerically identical (both are a x1.12 gap). A per-leaf {disposition, view_tag} is the minimum information that makes the tree's numbers self-identifying and the diff gate sound. Its absence is an under-specification, not a neutral omission.

independent_computation.step_5_verdict_logic: old_value_correct would require that no combat leaf in this scenario is view-dependent. S1 and S3 affirmatively refute that: two team-wide amplifiers with different type scopes (all vs magic-only) and different gates (4 s window vs 700 u aura) coexist on one roster. both_wrong would require positive evidence that leaf-path -> {disposition, view_tag} is the wrong shape; the shape carries exactly the two axes the wiki text shows are needed (what kind of value this leaf is, and under which view it was computed), and no evidence in the permitted tree contradicts it. Therefore new_value_correct.

confidence_and_limits.level: structural / directional — high confidence; entry-level — unverified
confidence_and_limits.verified: That the leaf must exist, and that a two-field {disposition, view_tag} shape covers the two axes of ambiguity (damage-type/amplifier scope, and whose view) that the cached wiki text proves are present in this scenario.
confidence_and_limits.not_verified: The specific set of leaf paths in the map, the disposition vocabulary, the view_tag vocabulary, and each individual assignment. Those are defined only in src/ and the snapshot tooling, which runbook R-18/R-19 forbids this oracle from reading, and the new value was supplied as a shape rather than as concrete entries. This receipt does NOT certify any individual map entry.
confidence_and_limits.what_would_settle_the_rest: A second oracle pass permitted to read the disposition enum and the combat leaf inventory could check, per entry, that magic-typed leaves are tagged as carrying Unmake and physical/true leaves are not, and that post-window leaves are not tagged Vulnerable.

asides_flagged: docs/math-foundations.md section 5's formula-audit table has no row for 'increased damage taken' amplifier composition (S5), even though the table claims to cover 'every modeling family'. Whether these amps compose multiplicatively (x1.07 x 1.12 = x1.1984) or additively (1 + 0.07 + 0.12 = x1.19) is unpinned by the foundations doc — a 0.7 percentage-point ambiguity sitting directly under this scenario. Worth an explicit row.

The atom classifier files Abyssal Mask's Unmake as a plain `damage.magic` atom with empty parameters (S6) — the 12%, the 700-unit range, the 'from all sources' team-wide scope, and the fact that it is an amplifier rather than a damage source are all dropped. Imperial Mandate's Command likewise decomposes into `stack-transform-summon-resource.mark` + `crowd-control-mobility.immobilize` with no amplifier atom and no 7%/4 s parameters. There appears to be no `amplify`/`damage-taken` atom family at all.

Imperial Mandate's `simpleDescription` in data/items.json reads 'Defer damage until later.' and its `nicknames` are ['banner of command', 'flag'] — both look like stale carry-over from a previous incarnation of the item and match neither cached passive. Cosmetic, but it is cached data that would mislead a text-matching consumer.
